0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Moa-Mosch has a supernatural story to share.

24.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter any phrase containing “Ismella” to challenge the spirit on the bridge.

48.original: Do you want to hear a ghost story? Of course you do...

49.original: The old pig farm over yonder once belonged to a family known as the “Greelys.”

50.original: It was around, oh, ten winters ago now that their entire sty was butchered by a pack of wild animals. The farm never recovered, and the family scattered to the winds.

51.original: The Greelys' daughter and her betrothed sought refuge here in Wright, but misfortune's grasp would not surrender them so easily.

52.original: The lad was slain by Dikaiosyne last year, when the eater attacked our village...

53.original: And the lass, mad with grief, threw herself from the bridge that bears her family's name. Drowned right there in the river.

54.original: Ever since, folk have avoided that spot, convinced that Greely Bridge is haunted by the girl's anguished spirit.

55.original: You think the tale a tall one? Go to the bridge yourself, then, and call out her name─“Ismella.”

56.original: Go on, then. Stand atop Greely Bridge and call the spirit for yourself. “Ismella” was her name...

58.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing “Ismella” to call forth the spirit said to lurk beneath the bridge.

59.original: There were <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103> spirits!? Ah, I think I see─the young lady was with child...

60.original: ...It truly was the ghost of Ismella, then.

61.original: May their souls be returned to the sea of stars. We can but pray that such tragedy never again visits us in this lifetime...

62.original: And pray forgive my frivolous words from before. I had thought only to give you a fright, and instead you gifted those spirits with the peace they deserved. Thank you...
